contributor to MP (1879)

She married (1877) Henry Jenner.

According to Henry and Katharine Jenner ed.

Derek R.

Williams (London: Francis Boutle 2004) 265, she contributed ‘The Wooing of Gudrun in the Elf-World: A Saga of Nordland’ to MP (Christmas 1879).
